summary: New Found Gold Corp., a TSX/NYSE-A-listed Canadian gold developer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 16, 2026 news release declaring commercial production at its 100%-owned Hammerdown Gold Mine in Central Newfoundland. The milestone was met August 19, 2026, after 60 consecutive days averaging roughly 748 tpd throughput, 87.7% gold recovery and 2.92 g/t feed grade, versus criteria of 600 tpd, 80% recovery and 80% of planned grade. Hammerdown produced 9,140 ounces year-to-date, with a $6,271/oz average realized price. The PEA cites a $199.2M after-tax NPV5% base case. Not a special-situations event; watch ramp-up execution and Queensway advancement.
